subject.title: feat(mac): Quick Chat v2 — enable toggle, agent switching, zoom entrance, window screenshots

question: Must agent-aware global-scope full-chat navigation be completed before this PR lands, or is the documented Command-Return mismatch acceptable with a linked follow-up?
rationale: The branch intentionally ships a route-to-navigation mismatch for one new agent-switching path, and repository evidence does not establish maintainer acceptance of that user-visible tradeoff.

options.title: Fix navigation before merge
options.body: Thread the selected agent identifier through the WebChat opening contract, or disable Command-Return for unsupported non-default global routes so the opened chat always matches the accepted send.

options.title: Accept with canonical follow-up
options.body: Land only after real behavior proof and explicit owner acceptance, with the exact agent-aware navigation follow-up linked in the PR discussion.

recommendation.title: Fix navigation before merge
recommendation.body: Thread the selected agent identifier through the WebChat opening contract, or disable Command-Return for unsupported non-default global routes so the opened chat always matches the accepted send.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged Quick Chat feature and owns the recent implementation history for the affected macOS surfaces.
